sentences.text: Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies M. N. R.-10 (General Area)

**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme "Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies, M. N. R.-10 (General Area)" aims to increase agricultural production by supporting irrigation cooperative societies through the provision of pumps and electric motors for efficient water distribution.
**Who is this for:** Registered Societies, Individual; Category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment; Sector: Land and water resources

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies, M. N. R.-10 (General Area)&quot; by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to enhance agricultural yield in the state by offering assistance to irrigation cooperative societies formed by farmers of a common area. The support involves establishing water distribution systems using pumps and electric motors on wells and agar creeks to facilitate effective irrigation.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Monetary Benefit:** Financial assistance for setting up irrigation infrastructure (such as pumps and motors) for cooperative societies.

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the District Registrar's Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the [application form](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/ViewForm.aspx). **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the District Registrar's Office. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
**Tags:** Irrigation, Co-operative Irrigation Societies, Farm Productivity, Water Distribution
